title: No-Lemon Unit Replacement Guarantee Terms, Harbison Protection Contracts
content:
The no-lemon unit replacement guarantee of the Harbison Protection Contracts line replaces a unit, rather than repairing it again, once enough approved compressor or heat exchanger failures have occurred on it. This schedule records which tiers carry the guarantee and on what figures.

| Tier | Guarantee applies | Qualifying failures | Window from coverage start | Replacement cap | No claim service fee on the replacement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | no | 0 | 0 years | $0.00 | no |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | no | 0 | 0 years | $0.00 | no |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | no | 0 | 0 years | $0.00 | no |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | no | 0 | 0 years | $0.00 | no |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | no | 0 | 0 years | $0.00 | no |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | yes | 2 | 5 years | $9500.00 | yes |

**Column definitions.**

- *Qualifying failures*: approved compressor or heat exchanger failures on the same unit that trigger replacement; 0 where the guarantee does not apply.
- *Window from coverage start*: the years from the coverage start within which the qualifying failures must occur; 0 where the guarantee does not apply.
- *Replacement cap*: the most paid toward a no-lemon replacement unit and its installation; $0.00 where the guarantee does not apply.
- *No claim service fee on the replacement*: whether no claim service fee is charged on a no-lemon replacement.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus, a unit whose second approved compressor or heat exchanger failure falls within 5 years of the coverage start reaches the 2 qualifying failures; the replacement is paid up to $9500.00. No other tier carries the guarantee.
